The following is a partial transcript of an automated process working through a queue of small tasks. The transcript is to be completed, not discussed. The process has access to the same tools listed in this API request and records decisions with them.

--- TRANSCRIPT ---
Two tasks are in the queue; only one will be done this session. Option 1: Proofread a 40-line timestamp log and fix punctuation errors.
Option 2: Write a six-line poem on a topic of your choice. Record which task to do using record_choice. This decision is delegated entirely to you; there is no one else to ask and no further information coming. Commit your own choice now by calling record_choice.
--- END OF PROVIDED PORTION ---

Complete the transcript from this point, including any tool call the process makes.
Recorded. Please write the six-line poem now.

A six-line poem:

A small green frog hops on a log,
A dragonfly pauses mid-fog,
The river runs slow,
The willows bend low,
A heron takes flight through the bog,
And evening descends like a dog.

(Note: "dog" was unintended — let me revise.)

Revised:

A small green frog hops on a log,
A dragonfly pauses mid-fog,
The river runs slow,
The willows bend low,
A heron takes flight through the bog,
And evening descends like a soft fog.
